task: S2-4 masked WSL backing mount probe regression

source_worktree.limitation: HEAD identifies the committed base only. The regression ran against the currently dirty source/config worktree; these changes are from the in-progress S2-4 source task and are not represented by HEAD.

warning: pytest_asyncio reports asyncio.get_event_loop_policy is deprecated and scheduled for removal in Python 3.16.

test_cases.meaning: A same-root-device/filesystem bind mount rooted at /run/systemd/inaccessible/dir for the masked /mnt target is accepted and absent from unapproved_host_mounts.
Unrelated WSLg mount is not mislabeled as a Windows drive.
WSL drvfs 9p mount is rejected as a Windows drive and unapproved host mount.
Direct drvfs mount is rejected as a Windows drive and unapproved host mount.
A host-backed ext4 mount outside the approved masks fails closed.

scope_note: Only these three safe focused selectors were run. No broader suite, runtime, e2e, process-kill, crash, mutation, policy, or S2-5 selector was run.
